from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialItem(BaseModel):
    """Employee Benefits Payable data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in this document")
    employee_benefits_payable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The Employee Benefits Payable amount from the balance sheet, in yuan")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period of the financial statement")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text showing the reported amount and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_items: list[CompanyFinancialItem]
